name: YTMQ
summary: Host companion for YTMQ, the shared YouTube Music queue. Friends add songs from their phones; this links YouTube Music to your lobby and shows the code, QR, listeners and queue on the page and in your toolbar.
description:
YTMQ turns YouTube Music into a shared queue. You play the music on your computer; friends join your lobby from their phones at t3lluz.com/ytmq, search for songs and add them. Their picks play in your YouTube Music in order, with lyrics and now playing on every phone. This add-on is the host side:
  • Links YouTube Music to your lobby by itself. Create a lobby, press Connect YouTube Music, and every music.youtube.com tab follows it, across reloads and browser restarts.
  • A pill and panel on YouTube Music with the lobby code and a QR to scan, who is listening, the guest queue with who added each song, and songs that did not reach YouTube Music yet, with Retry. Drag it anywhere; double-click puts it back.
  • The lobby in your toolbar: the code and QR, what is playing on YouTube Music or Spotify with controls, and the queue, with or without a YouTube Music tab open.
Guests need nothing installed. Free, no account, no ads. Setup guide and docs: t3lluz.com/ytmq/docs Permissions
  • music.youtube.com: to put guest songs in your queue and show the panel.
  • t3lluz.com: to talk to your lobby.
It sends your lobby what YouTube Music is playing and the state of the queue, nothing else. Lobbies are deleted after 24 hours.
